# THSound supplied archive

THS221.zip was https://arcarc.nl/archive/Apps/T/THSound%20(FR)/THSound%20(FR)%202.21%20(2003)(Tony%20Houghton).zip. Tony Houghton, GPL v2; COPYING retained. The archive
includes source/build files as well as !System/310/Modules/Audio/THSound.
The archive is retained here as the packaging input; release packages include
the module, licence, help and attribution, without the archive.

!Help labels the distribution 2.21. Its module header reports 2.20 (04 Jul 2003).
Both the extracted Downloads module and archived module are byte-identical.
